response.action: To gain further insights into the physical nature of the predicted electrocatalysts for the OER, the oxygen K-edge XAS spectra in total electron yield (TEY) mode were measured for PSCF and PSCFM (Fig. 5a).

The pre-edge peaks below ~530 eV correspond to the oxygen hole states at the conduction band minimum (CBM) induced by the high valent metal³².PeaksAandBreflect the degree of hybridization between the oxygen 2p state and the transition metal 3d state⁴⁶,while peak C represents the interaction between the oxygen 2p state and the Sr 4d state, and peak D corresponds to the mixed state of the transition metal 4sp orbitals.

The overlap of metal 3d and O 2p orbital is further quantified and evaluated by calculating the metal-oxygen covalency, defined as the difference in band center between the metal d-band orbital and oxygen p-band orbitals.
